axi_register_wr.summary: AXI4 write-channel register slice: AW and B channels use simple bubble-inserting registers, W channel a two-entry skid buffer, each with registered valid/ready handshakes.

blocks.name: AW register slice
blocks.description: Simple register for write address channel with bubble cycles.

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave AW valid; loaded into output AW valid register.

anchors.name: s_axi_awready
anchors.why: Slave AW ready from registered early-ready of AW slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Write address captured into AW output register.

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Master AW valid driven from AW valid register.

anchors.name: m_axi_awready
anchors.why: Master AW ready clears AW output valid.

anchors.name: genblk1.store_axi_aw_input_to_output
anchors.why: Loads all AW fields from slave inputs into output registers.

blocks.name: W skid buffer
blocks.description: Output plus temp registers giving full-throughput W channel.

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Slave W valid into skid buffer output or temp slot.

anchors.name: s_axi_wready
anchors.why: Slave W ready from registered skid-buffer early ready.

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Write data captured into output or temp register.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Registered write data output of the W skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Master W valid from output valid register.

anchors.name: m_axi_wready
anchors.why: Master W ready decides direct transfer vs temp storage and early ready.

anchors.name: genblk2.temp_m_axi_wdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp slot holding W data when master stalls.

anchors.name: genblk2.temp_m_axi_wvalid_reg
anchors.why: Temp slot occupied flag; gates early ready and temp-to-output move.

anchors.name: genblk2.store_axi_w_input_to_output
anchors.why: Loads W input directly into output registers.

anchors.name: genblk2.store_axi_w_input_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads W input into temp skid registers when output stalled.

blocks.name: B register slice
blocks.description: Simple register for write response channel.

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Slave write-response valid from B register.

anchors.name: s_axi_bready
anchors.why: Slave B ready clears registered response valid.

anchors.name: m_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Master B valid loaded into slave response register.

anchors.name: m_axi_bready
anchors.why: Master B ready from registered early ready.

anchors.name: s_axi_bresp
anchors.why: Registered write response code to slave.

anchors.name: genblk3.store_axi_b_input_to_output
anchors.why: Loads B response fields into slave-side registers.

axi_register_rd.summary: AXI read-channel register slice: AR channel uses a simple bubble-inserting register stage, R channel uses a skid buffer with output and temp registers steered by store enables.

blocks.name: AR register stage
blocks.description: Simple register slice for the AR channel; inserts bubble cycles.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Slave AR valid captured into the AR output register stage.

anchors.name: s_axi_arready
anchors.why: Slave AR ready from registered ready, high when AR output buffer empties.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Master AR valid driven by the AR stage valid register.

anchors.name: m_axi_arready
anchors.why: Downstream AR ready clearing the AR stage valid.

anchors.name: genblk1.m_axi_araddr_reg
anchors.why: AR stage address register, representative of registered AR payload fields.

anchors.name: genblk1.m_axi_arid_reg
anchors.why: AR stage ID register driving m_axi_arid.

anchors.name: genblk1.m_axi_arlen_reg
anchors.why: AR stage burst length register driving m_axi_arlen.

anchors.name: genblk1.store_axi_ar_input_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable capturing all AR input fields into AR output registers.

anchors.name: genblk1.s_axi_arready_early
anchors.why: Next-cycle AR ready computed from next valid state.

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Slave read address captured by the AR register stage.

blocks.name: R skid output stage
blocks.description: R channel output registers and ready logic of the skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Master R valid loaded into output or temp valid of skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_axi_rready
anchors.why: Master R ready from registered skid-buffer ready.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Slave R valid driven from skid buffer output valid register.

anchors.name: s_axi_rready
anchors.why: Upstream R ready deciding output transfer versus temp storage.

anchors.name: genblk2.s_axi_rdata_reg
anchors.why: R output data register fed from m_axi_rdata or temp register.

anchors.name: genblk2.s_axi_rid_reg
anchors.why: R output ID register driving s_axi_rid.

anchors.name: genblk2.s_axi_rresp_reg
anchors.why: R output response register driving s_axi_rresp.

anchors.name: genblk2.s_axi_rlast_reg
anchors.why: R output last register driving s_axi_rlast.

anchors.name: genblk2.store_axi_r_input_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable writing master R fields directly into output registers.

anchors.name: genblk2.m_axi_rready_early
anchors.why: Next-cycle R ready from s_axi_rready and temp/output occupancy.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Master read data loaded into output or temp data register.

blocks.name: R skid temp buffer
blocks.description: Temp registers holding one R beat while slave is stalled.

anchors.name: genblk2.temp_s_axi_rdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp data holding a beat while output is stalled.

anchors.name: genblk2.temp_s_axi_rvalid_reg
anchors.why: Temp-occupied flag gating rready and refilling output from temp.

anchors.name: genblk2.store_axi_r_input_to_temp
anchors.why: Load enable writing master R fields into temp registers on stall.

anchors.name: genblk2.store_axi_r_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Selects temp registers instead of input as output register source.

axi_register.summary: AXI4 register slice wrapper that instantiates separate write-channel (AW/W/B) and read-channel (AR/R) register slices between slave and master ports.

blocks.name: write_channel_slice
blocks.description: AW/W/B register slice instance buffering write address, data and response.

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Write address entering the AW register stage of the write slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Write data entering the W skid buffer in the write slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AW channel valid from upstream master into write slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: W channel valid into the write skid buffer.

anchors.name: s_axi_wready
anchors.why: W channel ready back-pressure from write slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid from registered B channel.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Registered write data driven to downstream slave.

anchors.name: s_axi_awready
anchors.why: AW channel ready from write slice.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Registered write address to downstream slave.

blocks.name: read_channel_slice
blocks.description: AR/R register slice instance buffering read address and read data.

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Read address entering the AR register stage of the read slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data returned to slave side from the R skid buffer.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AR channel valid into the read slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid from the R skid buffer to slave side.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data from downstream slave entering R register stage.

anchors.name: s_axi_arready
anchors.why: AR channel ready from read slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_rready
anchors.why: Slave-side R ready controlling R skid buffer drain.

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Registered read address to downstream slave.

anchors.name: m_axi_rready
anchors.why: Master-side R ready from read skid buffer.
